depth_targets.title: Autokey (automatic per-resource key ring/key provisioning)
depth_targets.current_reason: Autokey provisions key rings and keys automatically when a resource is created, gated by an organization/folder policy and a dedicated key project. Vyomi doesn't model org policy or cross-project key provisioning, so there is nothing to wire this to.
